limiterDetail: The main limiter today is a combination of current and wind. Tara, Decabaitot, Alava, Turda, Barangonan and Culion run 1.0–1.7 kt now and build to 1.2–2.0 kt around 2–6 PM. ECMWF wind is 8–14 kt now and 12–16 kt from late morning to mid-afternoon (ECMWF day 12 kt, gusts 18). Rain is light and mostly over by 9 AM.

pagasa.detail: PAGASA: no gale, wind signal or heavy-rain warning for Calamian / MIMAROPA. Latest: Tropical Cyclone Warning, Super Typhoon Rosal (Champi) Signal #2 , Thu 22 Oct 4:46 AM PHT. Rosal is 645 km east of Calayan, Cagayan (205 kph winds), moving northwest at 20 kph, and leaves PAR by Sat 24. Signal #3 may be raised for Batanes. Strong to gale-force gusts are forecast for most of Luzon and Visayas today and Fri 23. The newest feed item is a Cagayan Valley flood advisory (5:11 AM), which does not cover Palawan.

changed.title: ⚠️ What changed since yesterday afternoon
items: Today is the POOR day, as forecast. The grounds snapshot moved from 1 GOOD / 10 MARGINAL / 4 POOR / 1 VERY POOR to 0 GOOD / 9 MARGINAL / 4 POOR / 3 VERY POOR. Panlaitan lost its GOOD rating on 13.5 kt wind, and Decabaitot (1.7 kt) and Alava (1.5 kt, 14 kt wind) joined Tara (1.6 kt) at VERY POOR. Wind rises to 12–16 kt by midday with gusts 18–19.

Supply timing is unchanged: arrivals thin out on Fri 23 from today's weak catch. Friday's own fishing eased a bit (10 kt, gusts 15, now mostly dry, down from 11 kt gusts 17), so Saturday's recovery looks a little firmer. Sun 25 is still the calmest day (3.5 kt).
PAGASA keeps Signal #2 on Super Typhoon Rosal (Champi) for the far north only (4:46 AM PHT). Nothing for Palawan, but strong to gale gusts are forecast for most of Luzon and Visayas today and Friday.

bestWindow.headline: Now to about 9 AM (Coron side), then tonight about 7 PM–1 AM
details: 6–9 AM: Coron and Galoc on 0.3–0.5 kt current and 10–12 kt wind, with a light shower (0.4 mm/h). Ciron is also workable (0.4–0.5 kt, 11–13 kt). Current stays slack to noon, but wind keeps rising.

7 PM–1 AM tonight: Coron, Galoc and Culion-side wind drops to 7–8 kt, with Coron and Galoc current easing from 0.6 to 0.3 kt by 10 PM. Panlaitan and Maglalambay ease to 10 kt and 0.3 kt around 9–11 PM.
Keep boats off Tara and Decabaitot all 24h, and off Turda and Alava this afternoon. Midday to 3 PM brings 13–16 kt to Tara, Turda, Decabobo and Nangalao.
